description: Behavioral interface inventory for the current compiler. Descriptions name responsibilities directly and do not cite replaceable planning artifacts.

system2_compiler.ir.description: Harness-neutral composition entry point. Validates inputs and returns a graph or errors without invoking a backend.

public_exports.compose: compose(base_path, overlay_paths, project_path, *, profile=None, dry_run=False, allow_newer_schema=False) -> CompileResult
public_exports.CompileResult: frozen result containing graph, errors, warnings, files_to_write, and report

system2_compiler.ir.graph.description: Frozen, serializable intermediate-representation dataclasses with no target mechanism fields on roles or contributions.

public_exports.System2Graph: versions, roles, gate graph, delegation, post-execution, maintenance, artifacts, contributions, profile, anchors, capabilities, blocking semantics, warnings, and quarantined byte-fidelity carriers
public_exports.Role: name, gate_role, write_scope, model_hint, capabilities, and pipeline flag
public_exports.Warnings: validation, structural, additive, semantic, and injection findings

system2_compiler.backends.base.description: Target-neutral lifecycle contract and result dataclasses.

public_exports.Backend: emit, uninstall, doctor, recompose_from_lock, lock_path, and read_lock_overlay_sources
public_exports.UninstallResult: removed and remaining overlays, removed artifacts, written files, preview, warnings, and errors
public_exports.DoctorReport: status, details, versions, overlays, composed flag, exit code, and validator availability

system2_compiler.backends.claude_code.description: Byte-compatible Claude projection and lifecycle. Consumes graph data and project-local lock/artifacts only.

system2_compiler.backends.pi.description: Pi projection, generated TypeScript gate, mixed-fidelity report, and project-local lifecycle.

system2_compiler.backends.codex.description: Codex plugin and skills projection, conditional user-hook installation, adapted-fidelity report, and lifecycle.

public_exports.codex_init: materialize user-scope hooks with absolute commands and backup-aware conflict handling
public_exports.codex_uninstall: remove System2 hooks and restore a recorded prior configuration when safe

system2_compiler.cli.description: Argument parsing and target-neutral dispatch for compile, lifecycle, profile, and Codex hook installation commands.

system2_compiler.plugin_adapter.description: Preserves the plugin composer command contract while pinning dispatch to the Claude backend.

public_exports.main: translate plugin arguments and return the compiler CLI exit code

compiler.tools.regen_all.description: Single deterministic generator and freshness checker for bundle, Codex, and Pi artifacts.

public_exports.stale_message: return the standard artifact-specific regeneration diagnostic

constraints: contains structured workflow intent rather than target hooks, tools, or permission modes
carries ordered contributions and all warnings needed by backends

CapabilityDescriptor.shape: backend, version, and a capabilities object whose records contain status and mechanism
constraints: every capability present in the graph has a descriptor record
mechanism text describes actual target behavior

DegradationReport.shape: target-specific envelope containing every graph capability and its status, mechanism, and applicable flags
constraints: native maps to enforced, adapted maps to gated, advisory and unsupported map to neither
stable JSON formatting and key order
no native or enforced-at-rest capability claim
safety gates are adapted and gated
FIDELITY text states trust and coverage limitations
product modules are verbatim compiler copies
BUNDLE.json records the compiler source hash
the freshness companion is generated but excluded from the self-referential product hash
